第一章 两个穿越女(1)

三月，桃红李白的季节。

清湛的天空中时不时飘来片片千变万幻的云朵，似羊儿，似桃花，像繁华的十里扬州。先前刚下过一场雨，洗涤出这片雨后晴空。

回廊下，挂着一盆盆垂瀑似的兰花，有红的、粉紫、淡蓝……姹紫嫣红，沾了雨水的花瓣儿更显娇嫩，彷佛那不禁碰触的柳絮，风吹雨残，轻轻一扬，随风东西去。

很平静地，一如往昔，在兴武侯府里，几乎每一日都如今日般安静平和，有点亮不太亮的昏暗中一抹浅浅的金色光芒从东边跃出，一点一点地浸染，光照大地。

下人们开始忙碌了。

最先动起来的是厨房，烧热水的烧热水，淘米下锅的淘米下锅，切菜剁肉的双手忙个不停，准备全府人的早膳，从简单的枣熬粳米粥到做工繁复的雪片糕、鹅油酥卷，猪肉松花小卷、千层油糕、如意卷、香炸桂鱼、溜肉段……

厨房的香气飘得很远，飘过年前新上漆的小楼，飘过初长莲叶的湖面，飘过有着垂花门的院落，似有若无地唤醒守夜的小丫头，伸直懒腰打哈欠。

“软玉，你又睡着了。”

一名扎着双髻，年约十岁的小丫头轻推榻上的绿衣丫头，怕惊动睡房里的小姐，特意压低了声音。

“没……没有，只是打个盹而已，没睡。”明明一脸困意的小丫头十分惊慌的下榻，努力睁大一双睡眼惺忪的眼睛。

“瞧瞧你的眼屎都有豆子大了，还不快去净净面，一会儿夫人瞧见了又要数落了。”不是不能睡，而是不可以睡得太沉，免得听不见睡房里面的动静，没把小姐伺候好。

温香是家生子，家中一连数代都在府里为奴为仆，她有两个性情纯朴的兄长，一个老实本分的姊姊在西院，爹娘都是实在人，娘亲在花房干活，她爹则负责马车的看顾。

他们一家人很平凡，没什么心眼，主子说干啥他们就干啥，从不说不。

最大的大同是主子。

兴武侯府单看“兴武”两字，便知是马上立下了战功，福荫子孙，三代以前是武将，渐渐转为文官。

最为人津津乐道是他们的家规，年过四十未有子嗣方可纳妾，妾生子由嫡母抚养，妾只是个摆设，生子用，一旦确定有孕便不再同房，有孕的侍妾交由嫡妻看管，直至生产。

不过人一相处久了岂会无情，难免衍生出许多不必要的纷扰，好在近两代的兴武侯府并无这方面的困扰，府中男丁所娶的妻室皆有所出，“侍妾”这玩意儿原则上不存在。

逢场作戏有，沾沾荤味，但引进府里的绝无，家规甚严。

有监于此，所以兴武侯府的人丁并不旺盛，嫡系的儿孙屈指可数，在传承香火一事上便显得有些心余力绌。

上一代的老侯爷生有两儿一女，仍健在的他早年立下不世功绩，与先帝打出万里江山，情同手足，同食同寝，在战场里拚搏出的交情是铁杆的兄弟，得了五代袭爵不降等。

但是君臣之间最怕功高震主。

先帝一驾崩，曾经的深恩厚待也跟着烟消云散，为了不让新帝找上兴武侯府麻烦，正值壮年的老侯爷毅然决然的交上兵权，并在令人错愕的眼光下迅速分家，一分而二。

虽然还住在一起，可是偌大的一座府邸已从中间分成两半，东院属于现任侯爷赵汉阳，院落多且大得多，方便招待来客，和人应酬往来，漆红的大门朝东开。

西院小了约三分之一，住着二老爷一家人，他有二子一女，长子永慕，八岁，次子永项，五岁，女儿若莹六岁。

“起来了、起来了，你别吓我，你先去叫小姐起床，我洗个脸就过去。”面上还有睡时压出的印痕，八、九岁大的软玉慌慌张张的往外跑，就怕起晚的自己会被夫人责骂。

“好啦、好啦，你去吧，小姐先由我伺候，你快去快回，别耽搁了，小姐醒来找不到人你就得挨罚。”她们为人奴婢的不可离主子左右，要随传随到，不能马虎。

尤其是她们家小姐，敷衍不得，外表看似迟钝，傻里傻气的，其实精得很，比以聪慧着称的二小姐还要聪明。

“小姐，你醒了吗？”温香轻声的低唤。

“没醒，我还在睡，不要吵我，小孩子没睡够会长不大。”软糯糯的声音好似糯米糕，黏乎黏乎的。

“小姐，不能再睡了，今儿个是初十，得向老太君请安，你不好再赖床。”一会儿夫人就会使人来催了。

每逢有五、十的日子，东、西两院的子孙都得向住在两院正中央的老太君请好问安，让老人家瞧瞧儿孙好不好，增进感情，一家子和和乐乐的，不因分成两家而生疏。

秋香色的软被里发出猫呜似的呻吟，“又到了初十呀！温香，我爬不起来，我想睡觉。”

睡眠很重要，她到底知不知道？没睡足五个时辰有碍发育，七岁的她还在长身体，要多吃多睡，个头才能长得高。

“小姐，等请完安再回来睡个回笼觉也不迟，奴婢哄你睡。”温香从黄花梨木柜子取出一套浅紫带粉的衣裙，搭配粉紫绣丹桂、鞋面上缝有两颗金色铃铛的鞋子。

兴武侯的大小姐很喜欢铃铛，金的、银的、铜制的，她喜欢听铃铛摇的声响，哪里有铃铛声就有她。

“不要。”赵若瑾使起小性子，将团花锦被拉高盖住头，只露出一头鸦黑发丝，小人儿有很重的起床气。

“小姐，你再不起床，二小姐就要来闹你了。”一说起府里的二小姐，温香脸上露出无奈的神情。

兴武侯府的大小姐、二小姐是双生子，众所皆知是府里侯爷、夫人、少爷们捧在手心哄护的宝贝儿，是一对最最矜贵的明珠，凡有好的先往她们面前送，疼若眼珠子似。

可是明明是长得一模一样的孪生千金，个性却是天差地别，大小姐赵若瑾看起来傻气，人有些懒，做什么都提不起劲，松松懒懒的不想动，学起东西比其他人慢，天生的牛步，叫人看了为她着急。

而二小姐赵若瑜却是刚好相反，她活泼好动，见人就笑，小小年纪便反应灵敏，两眼有神明亮，每一天都活得生动，有滋有味，风头之健一时无二，嘴巴甜得让人腻味。

只是奇怪，老侯爷很是偏爱常常走神的大孙女，对能言善道、口齿伶俐的二孙女反而不喜，他老人家一张冷脸有着沙场上嗜血惯的武将杀伐决断的凌厉，见谁都是不苟言笑的冷视，唯独赵若瑾能软化他面上的冷硬线条，让他露出一抹笑意。

这件事叫人猜不透，为什么是这个呆傻的丫头呢？而非嘴甜的小孙女，老人家喜欢笨小孩？

也许是缘分吧！天生有股浓得化不开的祖孙情，赵若瑾傻不愣登的模样合老侯爷眼缘，一见她呆萌呆萌的样子就想笑。

“你们不会挡住赵若瑜呀！她一来就把她打出去。”那个要命的魔鬼，真是个阴魂不散的。

一听到主子孩子气的话语，温香失笑，道：“小姐，二小姐是你亲妹妹，你不能连名带姓的喊她。”

小小的脑袋钻出半颗，“我不能当自己是独生女吗？”

她讨厌双胞胎，尤其是打算祸害她的“穿越人”。

没错，是穿越者，兴武侯府里两个从现代穿越的灵魂。

赵若瑾打小就晓得这个脑子有洞的双胞胎妹妹是穿越的，她们从同一个时代来，赵若瑜是天津人，有点天津口音，她改了很多年才改过来，死时应该才二十出头岁，刚入社会不久，在日商公司工作，专长口译的美丽秘书。

Chapter 1 Two time-traveling women (1)

March is the season of pink and plum blossoms.

From time to time, ever-changing clouds float in the clear sky, like sheep, like peach blossoms, and like the prosperous ten-mile Yangzhou.It had just rained before, washing out the clear sky after the rain.

Under the corridor, there are pots of orchids hanging like waterfalls, including red, pink, purple, light blue... colorful, and the petals soaked in rain are even more delicate, like catkins that cannot help but be touched. The wind blows the rain and leaves, gently fluttering, and goes east and west with the wind.

Very quietly, just like in the past, in Xingwuhou Mansion, almost every day is as quiet and peaceful as today. In the somewhat dim darkness, a shallow golden light jumps out from the east, saturating it little by little, illuminating the earth.

The servants started to get busy.

The first thing to move was the kitchen, heating water, washing rice and adding it to the pot, hands chopping vegetables and meat, busy preparing breakfast for the whole family, from simple jujube and glutinous rice porridge to complicated snowflake cakes, goose fat rolls, pork and pine flower rolls, thousand-layer oil cake, Ruyi rolls, fried mandarin fish, pork slices...

The aroma from the kitchen floats far away, past the small building that was newly painted years ago, across the lake where lotus leaves are growing, and across the courtyard with the hanging flower door. It seems to wake up the little girl watching the night, stretching and yawning.

"Nephrite, you fell asleep again."

A little girl about ten years old with buns in buns gently pushed the girl in green on the couch. She deliberately lowered her voice for fear of disturbing the young lady in the bedroom.

"No...no, I just took a nap, I didn't sleep." The little girl, who was obviously sleepy, got down in panic and tried to keep her sleepy eyes wide open.

"Look at the poop in your eyes, it's as big as a pea. Why don't you go clean your face quickly? Madam will scold you when she sees it soon." It's not that you can't sleep, but you can't sleep too deeply, lest you can't hear what's going on in the bedroom, and you won't serve the lady well.

Wen Xiang was born in a family where several generations of her family had been slaves in the house. She had two simple-tempered brothers and an honest and dutiful sister in the west courtyard. Both her parents were real people. Her mother worked in the flower house, while her father was responsible for taking care of the carriage.

Their family is very ordinary and has no big ideas. They do whatever their master says and never say no.

The greatest Datong is the master.

Just by looking at the word "Xingwu" in the Xingwu Marquis Mansion, one can tell that he immediately made military exploits and that Fuyin's descendants, who were military generals three generations ago, gradually became civil servants.

The most talked about is their family rules. Only those who are over forty and have no heirs can take concubines. The concubines will be raised by the aunt's mother. The concubine is just a decoration, used for giving birth to children. Once it is confirmed that she is pregnant, she will no longer have sex with her. Pregnant concubines will be handed over to the aunt's wife to take care of them until they give birth.

However, how can people be ruthless after being together for a long time, which will inevitably lead to a lot of unnecessary troubles. Fortunately, in the past two generations, the Xingwu Hou Mansion has not had such troubles. The men in the house have all married wives who have had problems, and the concept of "concubine" does not exist in principle.

There were some who acted on occasion and had meat tastes, but they were never brought into the house. The family rules were very strict.

Because of this, the population of Xingwuhou Mansion is not prosperous, and there are only a handful of direct descendants, so it seems to be somewhat incapable of inheriting the incense.

The old Marquis of the previous generation had two sons and one daughter. He was still alive and made unparalleled achievements in his early years. He fought thousands of miles with the late emperor. They were brothers and sisters, ate and slept together, and the friendship they forged on the battlefield was that of an iron-clad brother. He won the title of the fifth generation and was not demoted.

But the greatest fear among monarchs and ministers is that great achievements will shock the master.

As soon as the late emperor passed away, the deep kindness and kindness he had received also disappeared. In order to prevent the new emperor from causing trouble to the Xingwu Marquis Mansion, the old Marquis in his prime resolutely handed over military power, and quickly separated the family into two parts under the astonishing eyes.

Although they still live together, the huge mansion has been divided into two halves in the middle. The east courtyard belongs to the current Marquis Zhao Hanyang. It has many courtyards and is much larger, which is convenient for entertaining visitors and socializing with others. The painted red door opens to the east.

The west courtyard is about one-third smaller and houses the second master's family. He has two sons and one daughter. The eldest son Yongmu is eight years old, the second son Yongxiang is five years old, and his daughter Ruoying is six years old.

"Get up, get up, don't scare me. You go and ask the lady to get up first. I'll wash my face and come over." There were still marks on her face from when she slept. The eight or nine-year-old nephrite ran out in a panic, fearing that she would be scolded by her wife for getting up late.

"Okay, okay, you go ahead. I will take care of you, young lady. Go and come back quickly. Don't delay. If you can't find anyone when you wake up, young lady, you will be punished." They are slaves and must not leave their master's side. They must be there at any time and cannot be careless.

Especially their young lady, who is not very perfunctory, looks slow and silly on the outside, but is actually very smart, even smarter than the second lady who is famous for her intelligence.

"Miss, are you awake?" Wen Xiang called softly.

"I'm not awake yet. I'm still sleeping. Don't disturb me. Children won't grow up if they don't get enough sleep." The soft and waxy voice was like glutinous rice cakes, sticky.

"Miss, I can't sleep anymore. Today is the tenth day of the Lunar New Year. I have to say hello to the old lady. You don't want to stay in bed any longer." After a while, the lady will send someone to urge her.

Every fifth and tenth day, the children and grandchildren of the east and west courtyards have to say hello to the old lady who lives in the center of the two courtyards, so that the old man can see how their children and grandchildren are doing, so as to enhance their relationship. The family members will be happy and happy, and they will not be alienated by being divided into two families.

A cat-like moan came from Qiuxiang's soft quilt, "It's the tenth day of the lunar month again! Wenxiang, I can't get up, I want to sleep."

Sleep is very important, does she know it?Not sleeping for five hours hinders growth. At seven years old, she is still growing. She needs to eat more and sleep more to grow taller.

"Miss, it's not too late to come back and take a nap after you're done. I'll coax you to sleep." Wen Xiang took out a light purple and pink dress from the huanghuali wood cabinet, paired with pink and purple shoes embroidered with red osmanthus and two golden bells sewn on the upper.

The eldest daughter of Marquis Xingwu likes bells very much, made of gold, silver or copper. She likes to hear the sound of bells ringing. She is there wherever there are bells.

"No." Zhao Ruojin lost her temper and pulled the brocade quilt up to cover her head, revealing only a head of raven-black hair. The little person was very anxious to wake up.

"Miss, if you don't get up, the second young lady will come to trouble you." When talking about the second young lady in the house, Wen Xiang showed a helpless look on his face.

The eldest and second young ladies of the Xingwu Marquis Mansion are twins. It is known to everyone that they are the treasures held and protected by the marquis, his wife, and the young masters in the mansion. They are a pair of the most precious pearls. Anyone who has good things will be sent to them first, and it hurts like eyeballs.

However, they are twin daughters who look exactly the same, but their personalities are completely different. The eldest daughter, Zhao Ruojin, looks silly, a bit lazy, and has no energy to do anything. She is lazy and does not want to move. She is slower than others in learning things. Her natural gait makes people anxious for her.

The second young lady, Zhao Ruoyu, is just the opposite. She is lively and active, laughs when she sees people, has quick reactions at a young age, has bright eyes, lives a vivid and interesting life every day, is as strong as ever in the limelight, and has a sweet mouth that makes people sick.

It's just strange that the old Marquis prefers his eldest granddaughter who is often distracted, but dislikes his second granddaughter who is well-spoken and articulate. His cold face has the sharpness and determination of a bloodthirsty general on the battlefield. He looks at everyone with a stern cold expression. Only Zhao Ruojin can soften the cold and hard lines on his face and make him smile.

This matter is confusing, why is it this silly girl?Instead of a sweet-tongued granddaughter, the old man likes a stupid child?

Maybe it’s fate!Born with a strong love between ancestors and grandchildren, Zhao Ruojin's silly and nonchalant look suited the old Marquis's eye, and he wanted to laugh when he saw her cute and cute look.

"You won't stop Zhao Ruoyu! Beat her out as soon as she comes." That deadly devil is really haunting.

Upon hearing her master's childish words, Wen Xiang laughed and said, "Miss, the second young lady is your biological sister. You can't call her by her first name."

Half of his little head popped out, "Can't I just think that I'm an only child?"

She hates twins, especially the "time travelers" who plan to harm her.

That's right, they are time travellers, two souls in the Xingwu Hou Mansion who have traveled from modern times.

Zhao Ruojin has known since she was a child that this twin sister with a hole in her brain has traveled through time. They are from the same era. Zhao Ruoyu is from Tianjin and has a slight Tianjin accent. It took her many years to change it. She must have been in her early twenties when she died. She had just entered the society and worked in a Japanese company. She was a beautiful secretary who specialized in interpretation.
